proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ t i j k hij hik hjk
  have hall : ∀ l : Fin 3, l = i ∨ l = j ∨ l = k := by decide +revert
  have hu : (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 3)) = {i, j, k} := by decide +revert
  intro hr
  have hth : (EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.mk (midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k)) (dist (t.points j) (t.points k) / 2)).IsDiameter (t.points j) (t.points k) := by
    refine ⟨?_, rfl⟩
    simp [EuclideanGeometry.mem_sphere, dist_left_midpoint]
    ring
  have hi : t.points i ∈ (EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.mk (midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k)) (dist (t.points j) (t.points k) / 2)) :=
    (EuclideanGeometry.Sphere.angle_eq_pi_div_two_iff_mem_sphere_of_isDiameter hth).mp hr
  have hd : ∀ l, dist (t.points l) (midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k)) = dist (t.points j) (t.points k) / 2 := by
    intro l
    rcases hall l with rfl | rfl | rfl
    · exact hi
    · exact hth.left_mem
    · exact hth.right_mem
  have hm : midpoint ℝ (t.points j) (t.points k) ∈ affineSpan ℝ (Set.range t.points) :=
    affineSpan_pair_le_of_mem_of_mem (mem_affineSpan ℝ (Set.mem_range_self j)) (mem_affineSpan ℝ (Set.mem_range_self k))
      (AffineMap.lineMap_mem_affineSpan_pair _ _ _)
  have hO := t.eq_circumcenter_of_dist_eq hm hd
  have hH : t.orthocenter -ᵥ t.circumcenter = (t.points i -ᵥ t.circumcenter) + (t.points j -ᵥ t.circumcenter) + (t.points k -ᵥ t.circumcenter) := by
    rw [t.orthocenter_vsub_circumcenter_eq_sum_vsub, hu, Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hij, hik]), Finset.sum_insert (by simp [hjk]), Finset.sum_singleton, add_assoc]
  have h0 : (t.points j -ᵥ t.circumcenter) + (t.points k -ᵥ t.circumcenter) = (0 : V) := by
    rw [← hO, left_vsub_midpoint, right_vsub_midpoint, ← smul_add, vsub_add_vsub_cancel, vsub_self, smul_zero]
  apply vsub_left_injective t.circumcenter |>.eq_iff.mp
  rw [hH, add_assoc, h0, add_zero]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → EuclideanGeometry.angle (t.points j) (t.points i) (t.points k) = Real.pi / 2 → t.orthocenter = t.points i
